description: This file defines a REST controller class 'ProjectRestEndpoint' that handles HTTP requests related to 'Project' entities. It provides endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting projects, utilizing service and mapper classes for business logic and data transformation.

classes.name: ProjectRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller managing Project operations via HTTP endpoints, utilizing service and mapper dependencies for processing.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving a Project resource by projectId.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new project using provided ProjectResource data.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Handles DELETE request for removing a project identified by projectId.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing project with provided ProjectResource data.
